fullText.simplified:
二十三、我的孩子

    金山寺被水淹了，城里许多房子也被水淹了。
    “白素贞！你大胆！”法海手托钵盂站在被淹的金山寺上方。
    钵盂在他手里闪着金光，然后慢慢变大，慢慢变大，最后变成了一座金塔。金塔飞向白素贞和小青，把两人向地面压去。海水慢慢下去，天空开始变晴。
    白素贞和小青的法力正在慢慢消失，她们被金塔压着，慢慢被压向地面。
    “不！”许仙大哭着去拉法海，“大师！求求您！不要杀她们！”
    法海一点儿都不想听。他用了一个法术，许仙马上不能动，也不能说话了。他只能流着泪，看着空中的金塔一点点把白素贞和小青压向地面。
    就在这时，白素贞的肚子疼了起来。她的脸色变了，“这孩子……来得真是时候。”
    小青被金塔压得说不出话，但她看出来了，白素贞的肚子在动，她的孩子要出生了。
    “姐……姐……怎么……办？”
    白素贞不说话，她已经说不出话了。金塔压得她没有力气说话了，但是她的肚子还在动。
    不行，我的孩子还没有出生，我不能放弃！我要用力！我要把孩子生下来！
    “啊！”一声哭声，孩子出生了！
    白素贞的力气用完了。她抱起孩子，笑着流泪。这孩子真可爱啊！是个男孩！以后他会长得像谁呢？现在真看不出来，但是别人都说男孩像妈妈，女孩像爸爸。所以，以后他会像我吗？以后……以后，他还有以后吗？我的孩子还有以后吗？
    旁边的小青已经不动了。白素贞也不能动了，但她还紧紧抱着孩子。孩子像是知道了母亲的难受，一直大哭。
    这时，塔底出现了一小片金光。金光强而有力，它托住了压下来的金塔。金光里，一个女子的声音说：“白素贞，你水淹金山寺，害死了多少人，这是多大的错！”
    白素贞听出来了，这个声音她听过，是南极仙翁那个女弟子的声音。
    她高兴地流着泪说：“我知道错了……对不起……我接受死……但求你救救我的孩子……他……没有做错什么……”
    金光没有说话，但是它保护住了白素贞和孩子。
    白素贞笑了，用最后一点力气说：“谢……谢……求你……小青……”
    白素贞睡着了，她什么都不知道了。
    金塔继续向下压，最后落在了城外的高山上。
    塔底一道金光飞出，金光中有一个刚出生的孩子和一条又大又粗的青蛇的身影。
    许仙看到那两个身影，流着泪的脸变得有些吃惊，但马上他就明白了，更多的泪开始往下流。
    “那是……我和夫人的孩子啊！”
fullText.traditional:
二十三、我的孩子

    金山寺被水淹了，城裡許多房子也被水淹了。
    “白素貞！你大膽！”法海手托缽盂站在被淹的金山寺上方。
    缽盂在他手裡閃著金光，然後慢慢變大，慢慢變大，最後變成了一座金塔。金塔飛向白素貞和小青，把兩人向地面壓去。海水慢慢下去，天空開始變晴。
    白素貞和小青的法力正在慢慢消失，她們被金塔壓著，慢慢被壓向地面。
    “不！”許仙大哭著去拉法海，“大師！求求您！不要殺她們！”
    法海一點兒都不想聽。他用了一個法術，許仙馬上不能動，也不能說話了。他只能流著淚，看著空中的金塔一點點把白素貞和小青壓向地面。
    就在這時，白素貞的肚子疼了起來。她的臉色變了，“這孩子……來得真是時候。”
    小青被金塔壓得說不出話，但她看出來了，白素貞的肚子在動，她的孩子要出生了。
    “姐……姐……怎麼……辦？”
    白素貞不說話，她已經說不出話了。金塔壓得她沒有力氣說話了，但是她的肚子還在動。
    不行，我的孩子還沒有出生，我不能放棄！我要用力！我要把孩子生下來！
    “啊！”一聲哭聲，孩子出生了！
    白素貞的力氣用完了。她抱起孩子，笑著流淚。這孩子真可愛啊！是個男孩！以後他會長得像誰呢？現在真看不出來，但是別人都說男孩像媽媽，女孩像爸爸。所以，以後他會像我嗎？以後……以後，他還有以後嗎？我的孩子還有以後嗎？
    旁邊的小青已經不動了。白素貞也不能動了，但她還緊緊抱著孩子。孩子像是知道了母親的難受，一直大哭。
    這時，塔底出現了一小片金光。金光強而有力，它托住了壓下來的金塔。金光裡，一個女子的聲音說：“白素貞，你水淹金山寺，害死了多少人，這是多大的錯！”
    白素貞聽出來了，這個聲音她聽過，是南極仙翁那個女弟子的聲音。
    她高興地流著淚說：“我知道錯了……對不起……我接受死……但求你救救我的孩子……他……沒有做錯什麼……”
    金光沒有說話，但是它保護住了白素貞和孩子。
    白素貞笑了，用最後一點力氣說：“謝……謝……求你……小青……”
    白素貞睡著了，她什麼都不知道了。
    金塔繼續向下壓，最後落在了城外的高山上。
    塔底一道金光飛出，金光中有一個剛出生的孩子和一條又大又粗的青蛇的身影。
    許仙看到那兩個身影，流著淚的臉變得有些吃驚，但馬上他就明白了，更多的淚開始往下流。
    “那是……我和夫人的孩子啊！”

sentences.pinyin: bái sù zhēn xiào le yòng zuì hòu yì diǎn lì qi shuō xiè xiè qiú nǐ xiǎo qīng
sentences.english: Bai Suzhen smiled and, using her last bit of strength, said, “Thank … you … please … Xiaoqing …”

sentences.simplified: 白素贞睡着了，她什么都不知道了。
sentences.traditional: 白素貞睡著了，她什麼都不知道了。
sentences.pinyin: bái sù zhēn shuì zháo le tā shén me dōu bù zhī dào le
sentences.english: Bai Suzhen fell asleep. She didn’t know anything anymore.

sentences.simplified: 金塔继续向下压，最后落在了城外的高山上。
sentences.traditional: 金塔繼續向下壓，最後落在了城外的高山上。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tǎ jì xù xiàng xià yā zuì hòu luò zài le chéng wài de gāo shān shang
sentences.english: The golden pagoda continued to press down. In the end, it settled onto a tall mountain outside of the city.

sentences.simplified: 塔底一道金光飞出，
sentences.traditional: 塔底一道金光飛出，
sentences.pinyin: tǎ dǐ yí dào jīn guāng fēi chū
sentences.english: A beam of golden light flew out from the base of the pagoda.

sentences.simplified: 金光中有一个刚出生的孩子和一条又大又粗的青蛇的身影。
sentences.traditional: 金光中有一個剛出生的孩子和一條又大又粗的青蛇的身影。
sentences.pinyin: jīn guāng zhōng yǒu yí ge gāng chū shēng de hái zi hé yì tiáo yòu dà yòu cū de qīng shé de shēn yǐng
sentences.english: In the golden light, there were the figures of a newborn child, and a large, thick green snake.

sentences.simplified: 许仙看到那两个身影，流着泪的脸变得有些吃惊，
sentences.traditional: 許仙看到那兩個身影，流著淚的臉變得有些吃驚，
sentences.pinyin: xǔ xiān kàn dào nà liǎng ge shēn yǐng liú zhe lèi de liǎn biàn de yǒu xiē chī jīng
sentences.english: Xu Xian saw the two figures, and his tear-streaked face showed a hint of surprise.

sentences.simplified: 但马上他就明白了，更多的泪开始往下流。
sentences.traditional: 但馬上他就明白了，更多的淚開始往下流。
sentences.pinyin: dàn mǎ shàng tā jiù míng bai le gèng duō de lèi kāi shǐ wǎng xià liú
sentences.english: But, he immediately understood, and more tears began to flow down his face.

sentences.simplified: “那是……我和夫人的孩子啊！”
sentences.traditional: “那是……我和夫人的孩子啊！”
sentences.pinyin: nà shì wǒ hé fū rén de hái zi a
sentences.english: “That is … the child of my wife and I!”

sentence_translations: 23. My Child
Jinshan Temple had been flooded, and many houses in the city had also been flooded.
“Bai Suzhen! How audacious!” Fahai stood above the flooded Jinshan Temple, holding his alms bowl in his hand.
The alms bowl shimmered with a golden light in his hand.
Then it slowly grew larger and larger, larger and larger, until it finally transformed into a golden pagoda.
The golden pagoda flew towards Bai Suzhen and Xiaoqing, pressing them towards the ground.
The seawater slowly receded, and the sky began to clear.
Bai Suzhen and Xiaoqing’s magical powers were gradually disappearing.
They were pressed down by the golden pagoda, slowly being pushed towards the ground.
“No!” Xu Xian cried out as he went to grab Fahai: “Master! I beg you! Don’t kill them!”
Fahai didn’t want to listen at all. He used a spell, and Xu Xian was immediately unable to move or speak.
He could only watch in tears as the golden pagoda slowly pressed Bai Suzhen and Xiaoqing down towards the ground.
Just at that moment, Bai Suzhen’s belly began to ache.
Her expression changed: “This child … really picked the best time to arrive.”
Xiaoqing was being pressed down by the pagoda and could not speak, but she could see that Bai Suzhen’s belly was moving.
Her child was about to be born.
Older  … Sister … what … should we do?”
Bai Suzhen did not speak. She was no longer able to speak.
The golden pagoda weighed down on her, leaving her with no energy to speak, but her belly was still moving.
No, my child hasn’t been born yet. I can’t give up! I need to push! I’m going to give birth to the child!
“Ahh!” There was the sound of crying. The child was born!
Bai Suzhen had exhausted her strength. She held the child, smiling through her tears.
This child is so cute! It’s a boy! In the future, who will he grow up to look like?
It’s hard to tell now, but people often say that boys resemble their mothers, and girls resemble their fathers.
So, will he resemble me in the future?
In the future … in the future … does he still have a future? Will my child have a future?
Xiaoqing, who was next to her, had stopped moving.
Bai Suzhen couldn’t move either, but she was still holding the child tightly.
The child seemed to sense his mother’s distress and cried continuously.
At that moment, a small patch of golden light appeared at the base of the pagoda.
The golden light was strong and powerful. It supported the golden pagoda as it pressed down.
In the golden light, a woman’s voice said, ..
.. “Bai Suzhen, you flooded Jinshan Temple and caused the deaths of so many people. What a grave mistake this was!”
Bai Suzhen recognized the voice.
She had heard it before, it was the voice of the Old Immortal of the South Pole’s female disciple.
She said with tears of joy, “I know I was wrong … I’m sorry … I accept death …
But please save my child … he … hasn’t done anything wrong …”
The golden light did not speak, but it protected Bai Suzhen and the child.
Bai Suzhen smiled and, using her last bit of strength, said, “Thank … you … please … Xiaoqing …”
Bai Suzhen fell asleep. She didn’t know anything anymore.
The golden pagoda continued to press down. In the end, it settled onto a tall mountain outside of the city.
A beam of golden light flew out from the base of the pagoda.
In the golden light, there were the figures of a newborn child, and a large, thick green snake.
Xu Xian saw the two figures, and his tear-streaked face showed a hint of surprise.
But, he immediately understood, and more tears began to flow down his face.
“That is … the child of my wife and I!”
